group.name: embedding_pool_cancellation
invariants: cancelled request cannot wait on unrelated saturated-pool work
queued cancelled work must not invoke the provider

validation.skip: existing opt-in live model test disabled intentionally

validation.actual: removing new synchronous input copy triggers DATA RACE between caller slice reuse and asynchronous MapSlice read

covered_scenarios: already-cancelled request performs no provider call
queued cancellation and deadline return without unrelated-worker release
accepted/running callback cannot pin cancelled caller; later chunks skip provider
failed pool submission cancels already-started work
multiple cancelled requests leave at most one ants Submit waiter per reused pooler
active/cancelled waiter wakes on Release; fully released pool reboots and same pooler works
caller may reuse large input slice immediately after cancellation without data race
successful vector order, closed-pool errors, existing provider-error/count-mismatch and concurrency fan-out regression suites

production_lifecycle_evidence.observed: dig.Provide(embedding.NewBatchEmbedder) followed by NewModelService; single constructor registration
modelService stores injected pooler; each model creation reuses s.pooler
one managed shared ants pool; cleanup invokes Release
retained type singleton instantiated at most once
only production call registration in container; remaining direct constructors are tests

limitations: ants.Submit has no context API: one coordinator may remain blocked per reused pooler until pool capacity is available or Release is called. submitSlot prevents each cancelled request from adding another ants waiter.
Already running providers that ignore context retain their own pool workers until they return; caller cancellation is prompt and queued callbacks never start provider work.

finding.actual: with pool capacity 1 held by unrelated work, request context cancelled after Submit waits; caller remains blocked until unrelated worker release. With controlled fake model returns nil error after cancellation and model called once.
finding.provenance: Original batch.go exact behavior inherited from 74434f730/d4fadf402; original version retained in /tmp/genyee-models-audit-20261113/batch-before.go. Additional confirmed partial-submit failure left started context-aware provider uncancelled until parent cancellation.
finding.fix: copy caller input before asynchronous scheduling; select caller context independently of ants Submit/wait; bound blocking Submit to one per singleton pooler; context-check callbacks; cancel derived provider context on every return; balance unaccepted waitgroup callback

root_review: Full batch implementation and regression tests read, singleton production lifetime traced, package terminal status verified. Input ownership and bounded deferred Submit explicitly retained.
